## Trigger

When consumers use the published harness, I want the approved integrity, comments, permission, installation, verification and checkpoint fixes released, so I can trust the existing operations.

## Scope

- `CHANGELOG.md`
- `src/basicly/__init__.py`
- `README.md`
- `docs/tutorial/first-loop.md`

## Release Plan

Required records in order: basicly-jho04rg, basicly-gcs3bu1, basicly-5rx5pn9, basicly-ejowvgn, basicly-49vecmn, basicly-6ip8ao9, basicly-1ys9rth, basicly-zq9i2m.1. Assess basicly-k6tpep.3 and basicly-0j2ubwq for this release. Preserve existing record ownership and parent relationships. Main session orchestrates isolated specialist worktrees and integrates in priority order. Complete current reproductions, smallest root-cause fixes, regressions, changelog fragments, standalone package validation, full integrated gates, release trial, publication and fresh consumer installation. Record deferrals and adjacent repairs. Preserve the source checkout user configuration edit byte for byte. No tracker redesign or broad caching work.

## Trigger

When the ledger is folded, merged or checked, I want every event stored once and every record sequence complete, so I can trust the tracker data and land lanes with basicly worktree merge.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. On main (2026-10-08), run basicly worktree merge basicly-x5orgwc --bead basicly-x5orgwc --mode full.
2. It refuses: pending-main.jsonl: basicly-h18rvov#ev-e7fffcffb8 does not re-mint from its own content, so the generation cannot be derived and nothing is rewritten.
3. The event exists in both events-0001.jsonl and pending-main.jsonl, and so do many others (for example basicly-9pyaygb.10#ev-23832dd45e, basicly-ztk3t6r#ev-d696890264); both copies trace to the shard fold e0684104 of 2026-10-06. Suspected, not proven: a union merge of the shard files after one side folded them.
4. cli.py fsck exits 2 with one finding: sequence-gap, severity broken, subject basicly-vkh0.30 (no event claims sequence 9).

## Scope

- `src/basicly/tracker.py`
- `.basicly/core/kit/tracker/fsck.py`
- `.basicly/core/kit/tracker/snapshot.py`
- `.basicly/core/kit/tracker/events.py`
- `.basicly/core/kit/tracker/cli.py`
- `tests/test_tracker_scrub_ledger.py`
- `tests/test_kit_tracker_shards.py`
- `tests/test_kit_tracker_fsck.py`
- `changelog.d/basicly-jho04rg.fixed.md`

## Trigger

When a mod author writes text inside JSX elements, I want the comments kit to treat it as text, so I can run fix without changing what the page shows.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. A .tsx file holds <Text>see http://x</Text>: check reports the prose comment //x</Text>; and fix would strip it, changing the JSX text.
2. A .tsx file holds <Text>Don't</Text>: check refuses it with: string opened with ' never closes, exit 2.
Found 2026-10-08 by the basicly-x5orgwc lane; fixing both needs a JSX children mode in the lexer.

## Scope

- `.basicly/core/kit/comments/lexer.py`
- `.basicly/core/kit/comments/jsx.py`
- `.basicly/core/kit/comments/scan.py`
- `tests/test_comments_jsx.py`
- `changelog.d/basicly-gcs3bu1.fixed.md`

## Trigger

When fix strips a prose comment, I want every tool directive on that line kept, so I can strip comments without a linter failing afterwards.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. A Python line reads: from data.persistence import (  # circular import guard  # noqa: PLC0415
2. python3 .basicly/core/kit/comments/cli.py fix leaves: from data.persistence import (
3. ruff then refuses with PLC0415. Measured by burndown-chart on 2026-10-08: 1 loss in 598 files.

- `.basicly/core/kit/comments/directives.py`
- `.basicly/core/kit/comments/scan.py`
- `tests/test_comments_directives.py`
- `changelog.d/basicly-5rx5pn9.fixed.md`
